verdict.rationale: Neon documents an official serverless driver (JS/TS) for Postgres access, a full REST Management API with published OpenAPI spec for codegen, and an official CLI/MCP tooling explicitly designed for AI-agent integration, giving AI-native developers first-party SDK-like building blocks. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK coverage (e.g. Python, Go) beyond the JS/TS serverless driver, and independent hands-on validation of SDK ergonomics.
